The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `26257` (see `CockroachDbBuilder.CockroachDbPort`)
- Port: `8080` (see `CockroachDbBuilder.CockroachDbRestPort`)
- Environment variable: `COCKROACH_DATABASE=defaultdb` (see `CockroachDbBuilder.WithDatabase(string)`)
- Environment variable: `COCKROACH_USER=root` (see `CockroachDbBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `COCKROACH_PASSWORD=` (see `CockroachDbBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Command: `start-single-node --insecure`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /health` to port `8080` is completed successfully.
